messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D Geometry Dash-style game where the player taps to the beat.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original neon rhythm-platformer called Pulse Runner, with generated beat audio and a 112 BPM circuit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive game UI, canvas-based gameplay, obstacles, collision, progress/best tracking, pause/retry/finish states, keyboard and touch controls, and sound toggle.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`; desktop and mobile screenshots were captured and inspected.

### Active
- Refine and verify the mobile layout after CSS changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture and inspect a fresh mobile JPEG after the latest CSS changes.
2. Test gameplay, pause/resume, collision, and completion in the browser; fix any issues found.
3. Summarize the result and note assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page structure and UI.
- `game.css`: Responsive styling and layout.
- `game.js`: Game logic, rendering, controls, and audio.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Screenshots read: `/tmp/opencode/pulse-runner.jpg`, `/tmp/opencode/pulse-running.jpg`, `/tmp/opencode/pulse-mobile.jpg`; the mobile screenshot predates the latest mobile CSS adjustments.
- Playwright initially reported missing Chromium; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` resolved it.
